page.notes: The first line is a fragment from the previous page, copied as printed ("lastini", the initial letters are missing). The last word is split by a line-end hyphen ("u-") and continues on the next page; the catchword "nā" is at the lower right and is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The ligature "st" in "ille-stam" was read as the "ct" ligature of "illectam" and is hyphenated as printed. The heading "LXXII." is set as a bare number and is written as a paragraph, per the rules. The page number is printed "49º" with a ligature, read here as 490.
